description: This file defines a Backbone class and several functions related to model loading, conversion, and backbone selection for a RetinaNet object detection framework. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and external library references.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: A class that stores information about different backbone architectures for the detection model, including custom objects and validation methods.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to return a RetinaNet model using the specified backbone.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to download ImageNet weights for the backbone.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Placeholder method to validate the backbone string.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Placeholder method to preprocess images for the backbone.

methods.name: backbone
methods.description: Function to return a backbone object based on the backbone name string.

methods.name: load_model
methods.description: Function to load a RetinaNet model with custom objects based on the specified backbone.

methods.name: convert_model
methods.description: Function to convert a training model into an inference model, optionally applying NMS and class-specific filtering.

methods.name: assert_training_model
methods.description: Function to assert that a given model is a training model with specific outputs.

methods.name: check_training_model
methods.description: Function to verify that a model is a training model and exit if not.
